about: Raw measurements behind M5C.7e2 (docs/COVERAGE.md 'After batch 4', ADR-0211): how common is a JS file that assigns a property of a global at the top level (process.env.NODE_ENV = ...), which TypeScript binds as a declaration of `process` in the repo, so before ADR-0211 every process.env read in the same service read as a runtime value. 'counts': GitHub REST GET /search/code (legacy engine, authenticated) total_count per query. 'repos': the first 20 non-fork hits for '"process.env.BABEL_ENV = " language:JavaScript path:scripts' (ejected create-react-app scripts, which set BABEL_ENV and NODE_ENV in scripts/start.js or build.js), one per repo, each with the total_count of 'repo:<repo> "process.env.REACT_APP_" path:src' (app files in the same package reading env vars; the legacy index misses some repos, so 0 is a lower bound). 4 of 20 read REACT_APP_ vars in src. Read by hand: velopert/velog-client's src/lib/api/apiClient.ts sets axios.create({ baseURL: host }) with host = process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development' ? '/' : process.env.REACT_APP_API_HOST || '/', so its env base was a hole there. Among the eval checkouts (eval/dist/e2-scan.mjs), the process form is only in batch 4's snagtime (scripts/postgres-runtime-check.mjs, scripts/demo-check.mjs, scripts/container-entrypoint.mjs); batch 1's mern-social (document.cookie = ...) and batch 3's Recipen (window.location.href = ..., document.title = ...) have the window/document form, which affects only window.location.origin and window.fetch reads.

readByHand.assigns: scripts/start.js (a hit for "process.env.BABEL_ENV = ", the ejected create-react-app script)
readByHand.reads: src/lib/api/apiClient.ts: const host = process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development' ? '/' : process.env.REACT_APP_API_HOST || '/'; axios.create({ baseURL: host })
